question: What independently replayable original-top regularity bounds follow on all96 retained baseline/spike40 PDP systems, using six fixed projections and original linear-top upper certificates?

claims.text: Verified graded projections and original linear-top certificates imply the reported intervals or positive-dimensional top quotients on the exact96 saved presentations.
No unmeasured exact degree, LFD, solving degree, performance improvement, universal FFD/LFD verdict or elite-base status is established; overlapping intervals do not order bases.

For the16 saved prime pairs, a checked invertible diagonal map identifies the original top-form ideals, hence their graded Hilbert functions and regularity convention agree. This says nothing about affine-selector ideal equivalence.
